I am a **former PhD student** and a **former scientific employee** at the **Chair of Econometrics and Quantitative Methods**, Faculty of Business Administration and Economics, [Paderborn University](https://www.uni-paderborn.de/en/). My training includes **statistics** and **data science** and the focus of my research so far is on **time series analysis** as well as the **development of statistical software** in this context, in particular for the [free software R](https://cran.r-project.org/). Nonetheless, I am also versatile in [MySQL](https://www.mysql.com/de/) and [Python](https://www.python.org/), which I appreciate more and more in my own workflows.
:::

<br>

This site functions both as a **personal website** and a **blog** (called **Stats Rsenal**) on topics related to data science, time series analysis, and programming. However, new blog posts will only appear irregularly. Regarding programming topics, I will mainly focus on R but also incorporate posts on SQL or Python from time to time.

If you have any **feedback** or **suggestions**, please feel free to **reach out** via [dominik.schulz.r\@gmail.com](mailto:dominik.schulz.r@gmail.com).
